# GitHub repository About metadata

[Curriculum home](../README.md) · [GitHub repository](https://github.com/hareramray/gcp-roadmap)

This file records the repository's intended About settings for maintainers. GitHub reads the sidebar description and topics from repository settings; editing this Markdown file alone does not update them.

## Description

Google Cloud learning roadmap: 92 detailed tutorials across 14 domains, with hands-on labs, capstones, study plans, and guidance on security, DevOps, data, AI, and SRE.

## Topics

```text
google-cloud, gcp, cloud-computing, learning-roadmap, tutorials, hands-on-labs, cloud-architecture, cloud-security, iam, networking, devops, terraform, kubernetes, gke, serverless, data-engineering, machine-learning, generative-ai, sre, finops
```

## Website and sponsorship

No separate project website is configured. The repository and its README are the project's entry point.

The Sponsor badge links to [Hareram's GitHub Sponsors profile](https://github.com/sponsors/hareramray). [FUNDING.yml](FUNDING.yml) configures GitHub's repository Sponsor button when present on the default branch. See [GitHub's funding configuration guide](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/displaying-a-sponsor-button-in-your-repository).

## Maintenance

Keep the tutorial/domain counts aligned with [the coverage map](../COVERAGE.md). The stars, forks, issue count, and last-commit badges use live GitHub data through Shields.io. Update the repository owner/name in badge URLs and the funding account if this project is transferred. Only show license, release, or build-status badges when the repository actually has those artifacts or checks.
